menu "ZBUS"

config ZBUS
    bool "Enable ZBUS"
    depends on MULTITHREADING
    help
      Enable the Zephyr Bus (ZBUS) subsystem.
      ZBUS is a publish/subscribe message bus for Zephyr RTOS.

if ZBUS

config ZBUS_LOG_LEVEL
    int "Log level for ZBUS"
    default 0
    range 0 4
    help
      Set the log level for ZBUS.

config ZBUS_OBSERVER_STACK_SIZE
    int "Stack size for ZBUS observer thread"
    default 1024
    depends on ZBUS_MSG_SUBSCRIBER
    help
      Stack size for the ZBUS observer thread.

config ZBUS_MSG_SUBSCRIBER
    bool "Enable ZBUS message subscriber"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      Enable the ZBUS message subscriber feature.
      This feature allows observers to subscribe to messages and receive them
      via a message queue.

config ZBUS_CHANNEL_SUBSCRIBER
    bool "Enable ZBUS channel subscriber"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      Enable the ZBUS channel subscriber feature.
      This feature allows observers to subscribe to channels and receive
      notifications when a message is published to the channel.

config ZBUS_RUNTIME_OBSERVERS
    bool "Enable ZBUS runtime observers"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      Enable the ZBUS runtime observers feature.
      This feature allows observers to be added and removed at runtime.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_PROBE_ERROR
    bool "Assert on ZBUS probe error"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if a message probe fails.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_CHAN_ADD_ERROR
    bool "Assert on ZBUS channel add error"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if adding a channel fails.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_OBS_ADD_ERROR
    bool "Assert on ZBUS observer add error"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if adding an observer fails.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_MSG_SEND_ERROR
    bool "Assert on ZBUS message send error"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if sending a message fails.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_MSG_SUBSCRIBE_ERROR
    bool "Assert on ZBUS message subscribe error"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if message subscription fails.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_CHAN_SUBSCRIBE_ERROR
    bool "Assert on ZBUS channel subscribe error"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if channel subscription fails.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_OBS_REMOVE_ERROR
    bool "Assert on ZBUS observer remove error"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if observer removal fails.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_CHAN_REMOVE_ERROR
    bool "Assert on ZBUS channel remove error"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if channel removal fails.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_MSG_UNSUBSCRIBE_ERROR
    bool "Assert on ZBUS message unsubscribe error"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if message unsubscription fails.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_CHAN_UNSUBSCRIBE_ERROR
    bool "Assert on ZBUS channel unsubscribe error"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if channel unsubscription fails.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_OBS_NOT_FOUND
    bool "Assert on ZBUS observer not found"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if an observer is not found.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_CHAN_NOT_FOUND
    bool "Assert on ZBUS channel not found"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if a channel is not found.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_MSG_NOT_FOUND
    bool "Assert on ZBUS message not found"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if a message is not found.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_OBS_ALREADY_SUBSCRIBED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS observer already subscribed"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if an observer is already subscribed.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_CHAN_ALREADY_SUBSCRIBED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS channel already subscribed"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if a channel is already subscribed.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_OBS_ALREADY_UNSUBSCRIBED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS observer already unsubscribed"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if an observer is already unsubscribed.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_CHAN_ALREADY_UNSUBSCRIBED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS channel already unsubscribed"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if a channel is already unsubscribed.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_MSG_ALREADY_UNSUBSCRIBED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS message already unsubscribed"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if a message is already unsubscribed.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_MSG_ALREADY_SUBSCRIBED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS message already subscribed"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if a message is already subscribed.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_MSG_NOT_SUBSCRIBED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS message not subscribed"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if a message is not subscribed.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_CHAN_NOT_SUBSCRIBED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS channel not subscribed"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if a channel is not subscribed.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_OBS_NOT_SUBSCRIBED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS observer not subscribed"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if an observer is not subscribed.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_OBS_NOT_UNSUBSCRIBED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS observer not unsubscribed"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if an observer is not unsubscribed.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_CHAN_NOT_UNSUBSCRIBED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS channel not unsubscribed"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if a channel is not unsubscribed.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_MSG_NOT_UNSUBSCRIBED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS message not unsubscribed"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if a message is not unsubscribed.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_MSG_NOT_PUBLISHED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS message not published"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if a message is not published.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_CHAN_NOT_PUBLISHED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS channel not published"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if a channel is not published.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_OBS_NOT_PUBLISHED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS observer not published"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if an observer is not published.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_MSG_NOT_RECEIVED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS message not received"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if a message is not received.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_CHAN_NOT_RECEIVED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS channel not received"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if a channel is not received.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_OBS_NOT_RECEIVED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS observer not received"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if an observer is not received.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_MSG_NOT_SENT
    bool "Assert on ZBUS message not sent"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if a message is not sent.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_CHAN_NOT_SENT
    bool "Assert on ZBUS channel not sent"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if a channel is not sent.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_OBS_NOT_SENT
    bool "Assert on ZBUS observer not sent"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if an observer is not sent.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_MSG_NOT_PROBED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS message not probed"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if a message is not probed.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_CHAN_NOT_PROBED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS channel not probed"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if a channel is not probed.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_OBS_NOT_PROBED
    bool "Assert on ZBUS observer not probed"
    depends on ZBUS
    help
      If enabled, ZBUS will assert if an observer is not probed.

config ZBUS_ASSERT_ON_MSG_NOT_READ
    bool "Assert on ZBUS message not read"
